### Props

| Name            | Type      | Required | Default | Description                                                                   |
| --------------- | --------- | -------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `enabled`       | `boolean` |          | `false` | Whether the flow is armed. A disabled flow is grey whatever its history says. |
| `lastRunStatus` | `string`  |          | `null`  | The status of the most recent run, or null when it has never run.             |
